name: mkmax
description: Pack planner for Mortal Kombat Mobile: which packs to buy, in what order, and where your Fusion Up Kards should go. Offline-ready PWA.

paragraphs: A pack planner for Mortal Kombat Mobile. Tell it which cards you're maxing, what's in the store and how much currency you have, and it works out which packs to buy, in what order, and where your Fusion Up Kards should go.
features: Purchase plan. For each currency (Souls, Blood Rubies, Dragon Krystals, or any you add) it recommends what to buy, putting limited-time packs first, and tells you when to save for a pack that hasn't started yet. Tap a…

Pack ranking. Compares packs by expected value per cost, showing your chance of each card you need per buy and about how many buys a copy takes. Kaskets are valued from the cards you don't own yet, so their odds update…
Fusion Up Kard plan. Spends character kards on the cheapest steps first, through ascension for Gold cards, and finishes gear to F10 one piece at a time.
Blood Ruby gear order. Maxes the Realm Klash gear one piece at a time, in an order you choose, before any other Blood Ruby buy, and forecasts the date each piece and the whole set will be maxed.
Ending-soon badge. The Packs tab, and the home-screen icon where the phone supports it, counts planned packs that end within a day.
